note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. Only one supplied datum is substituted; no preset states who may attend, any rule, any validity or any outcome. Coordinator decision (standing stress rule, 2026-09-26): the long-labels-stress texts are capped to lengths that fit every ratio; see that preset's description for the measurements.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Participant C came in from the entrance hall by the public route; the lens isolates the hall and C's tag, the value becomes 'restricted access as configured' and only C's route line re-routes through the other corridor and door to the same seat.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different inspected participant whose supplied route was the restricted one as configured; the substitution gives the public route, and only that route line re-routes. Different people and seats.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long labels, capped under the standing stress rule (coordinator decision 2026-09-26, AUTHORING item 20): every text is strictly longer than the baseline and the count equals the baseline (four people on four separated seats). Measured with the near-maximum set (six people, four of them on the two front tables, ~50-character labels) after trying the column and band panels at every width and the supplied tag widths: at 1080x1080 no composition fits between 22.5 and 20.1 px (panel column too tall) and below that seat labels stay unplaced, and at 1080x1920 seat labels stay unplaced at every size; with these capped texts every ratio fits (1:1 at 20.1 px).
